answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 150940 Country: India Title: If someone forgets to say Takbir-e-Tahrimah in salah in jamat. Question: If someone forgets to say Takbir-e-Tahrimah in salah in jamat. Answer ID: 150940 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 728/563/D=8/1438) It is fardh to say takbir-e-tahrimah, whether by pronouncing Allah Akbar or Allah Azam, as salah will not be valid without takbir-e-tahrimah. قال فى الدر من فرائضها التى لا تصح بدونها التحريمة قائماً – قوله التحريمة المراد بها جملة ذكر خالص مثل الله اكبر (الدر مع الرد ج 1 ص 326) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
